这是一个非常简单的工作流程，可帮助您将文本到图像生成数据保存到人类可读的 .txt 文件中。这将自动获取您的元数据并将其写入 .txt 文件。如果您知道如何修改工作流程，您还可以在其他工作流程中实现这种人类可读的简单提示保护程序技巧（不仅限于任何单个模型，我为 Flux.2 Klein 4B AIO 模型实现了早期的原型提示保护程序版本）。您将在具有工作流程的存档 (.Zip) 中找到它使用图像生成的所有保存的提示文件。此外，通过使用 Image Saver Simple 节点，您可以将元数据嵌入工作流程本身或单独保存工作流程。您将以这种方式在生成的每个图像的可读 .txt 文件中获得提示（与 EasyDiffusion 的 .txt 输出匹配） -

积极提示 -

------------------

杰作，最佳品质，highres，1girl，独奏，穿着华丽的黑色和金色丝绸和服，精致的金色凤凰和花卉刺绣，闪闪发光的金线，金属丝绸，优雅的发型，传统的 kanzashi 发夹，平静的表情，看着别处。杰德特尔02

背景：充满活力的日本禅宗花园，色彩缤纷的红金色调的神道寺庙，传统的拱形朱红色桥梁，郁郁葱葱的绿色枫叶，飘散在空中的樱花花瓣，清澈的锦鲤池，色彩缤纷的橙白色鱼儿在游动，睡莲，长满青苔的石灯笼。

灯光和风格：电影灯光、透过树叶的柔和阳光、光线追踪、浮世绘影响、锐利的焦点、鲜艳的色彩、丰富的纹理、8k 壁纸。

否定提示 -

------------------

（最差质量，低质量：1.4），（解剖结构不良），（模糊），（变形的手），（多余的手指），（缺失四肢），（毁容），文本，水印，签名，字母，低分辨率，裁剪，框架外，凌乱的头发，朴素的背景，现代服装，暗淡的颜色，单色，过饱和的皮肤，霓虹灯颜色，西式建筑。

种子 - 1045510200354078

步数 - 50

CFG-5.0

采样器 - 欧拉

降噪强度 - 1.0

正如您所看到的，如果您想在不同的工具（如 WebUI Forge 或 Easy Diffusion 或其他工具）上重复使用提示，这非常具有可读性，并且非常适合轻松参考重用。我唯一知道它可以有更多的是使用 LORA 的名称和权重以及调度程序名称。我不知道如何保存这些信息。

您可以从CivitAI下载您所需的Illustrious模型和使用的LORA（详情如下）。确保您安装了足够最新的 ComfyUI，并使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装此工作流程所需的任何节点，并将正确的文件（Illustrious 模型、LORA 等）放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、Z-Image Turbo、Flux.2 Klein 和 Flux.1 的其他工作流程。随意在您喜欢的东西上扔一些黄色的嗡嗡声。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的杰出模特，然后立即

#2.设置您想要的图像尺寸开始

＃3。然后输入你想要的图片提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 此工作流程的 LORA 使用是可选的，您可以在没有任何 LORA 的情况下使用它，也可以与 1 或 2 个或任何其他数量的 LORA 一起使用。要添加新的 LORA，请按顶部的 L 按钮，在新选项卡上使用 LORA Manager 找到您的 LORA，如果您想使用该 LORA，只需单击向上的风筝按钮

o.en:
This is a very simple workflow that helps you to save your Text to Image Generation Data into a human readable .txt file. This will automatically get and write your metadata to the .txt file. If you know how to modify workflows you can also implement this human readable easy prompt saver trick to other workflows as well (not limited to just any single model, I implemented an earlier prototype prompt saver version for Flux.2 Klein 4B AIO model). You will find all the saved prompt files that it generated with the images inside the Archive (.Zip) that has the workflow. Also with the Image Saver Simple node used you may embed the metadata with workflow itself or save the workflow for your work seperately. You will get your prompts in this way inside a readable .txt file for each image generated (matching EasyDiffusion's .txt outputs) -

Positive Prompt -

------------------

masterpiece, best quality, highres, 1girl, solo, wearing an ornate black and gold silk kimono, intricate golden phoenix and floral embroidery, shimmering gold thread, metallic silk, elegant hairstyle with traditional kanzashi hairpins, serene expression, looking away. Jeddtl02

Background: vibrant Japanese zen garden, colorful shinto temple with red and gold accents, traditional arched vermilion bridge, lush green maple leaves, cherry blossom petals drifting in the air, clear koi pond with colorful orange and white fish swimming, lily pads, mossy stone lanterns.

Lighting & Style: cinematic lighting, soft sunlight filtering through leaves, ray tracing, ukiyo-e influence, sharp focus, vivid colors, rich textures, 8k wallpaper.

Negative Prompt -

------------------

(worst quality, low quality:1.4), (bad anatomy), (blurry), (deformed hands), (extra fingers), (missing limbs), (disfigured), text, watermark, signature, letters, lowres, cropped, out of frame, messy hair, plain background, modern clothing, dull colors, monochromatic, oversaturated skin, neon colors, western style architecture.

Seed - 1045510200354078

Steps - 50

CFG - 5.0

Sampler - euler

Denoise Strength - 1.0

As you can see this is very much readable and ideal for easy reference reuse if you want to reuse the prompt on a different tool like WebUI Forge or Easy Diffusion or something else. Only thing I wised it could have more is to have name(s) and weight(s) of LORA(s) used and Scheduler Name. I could not figure out how to save these info.

You can download your necessary Illustrious model and LORA used from CivitAI (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you have latest enough ComfyUI installation and install any necessary nodes for for this workflow using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files (Illustrious model, LORAs etc) in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, Z-Image Turbo, Flux.2 Klein and Flux.1 . Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on stuffs you like.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Illustrious model first and now

#2. set your desired image dimensions to start

#3. then input your desired image prompt.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** LORA usage for this workflow is optional you can use it without any LORAs, use with 1 or 2 or any other number of LORAs. to add new LORAs press the L button on top to lunch LORA Manager on a new tab find your LORA and if you want to use that LORA just click the upward Kite button
